scope: Proposition 5.2 (The quadratic deficit) of the manuscript “A local Penrose inequality for conformal perturbations of Schwarzschild–anti-de Sitter data” (preprints/A-local-Penrose-inequality-for-conformal-perturbations-of-Schwarzschild-anti-de-Sitter-data-October-5-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 260 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 624b287b6675a962), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 24. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: On the real linear space of all smooth TT seeds with the prescribed decay, the first deficit coefficient is zero and the second coefficient c2[q] is a continuous, rotation-invariant, nonnegative quadratic form. For a finite-angular-type seed it is given by c2[q] = 1 16π Z M N  |q − Q(v)|2 + |U|2 + 2FJ0 s F  dV0, J0 s = −∆r2σ − 2 r2 + 6m0 r3 . (5.6) The last term is integrated on the spheres before radial integration. For every actual branch in Theorem 2.1, Dq(ϵ) = c2[q]ϵ2 + o(ϵ2 ). (5.7) In particular, c2[q] > 0 implies a strictly positive deficit for all sufficiently small positive ϵ.
